_instructions: Robot version history timeline. Each entry appears as a card on the Design Evolution timeline. 'dateRange' is a display string. Group by subsystem using 'subsystem' field. 'photos' is an array of up to 2 image paths (under /public) — shown side by side. Use empty string or omit a slot for a placeholder.

versions.name: Flap Intake
versions.changes: Flap behind intake to prevent over-consumption of artifacts. Intaking multiple artifacts jammed nearly 100% of the time.
versions.result: Jams were unacceptable — 100% jam rate with multiple artifacts forced a redesign.

versions.name: Centered Roller & Funnel
versions.changes: Centered roller and funnel system reduced jams compared to Gen 1.
versions.result: Jams reduced but inconsistency remained — still not competition-reliable.

versions.name: Vector Wheel Intake
versions.changes: Vector wheels + custom molded wheels + angled compression path. Consistent triple-intake with guided centering. Vector wheels directed artifact path reducing jams to near zero. Mechanical feed stop added to prevent 4th artifact from being retrieved.
versions.result: Jams reduced to near zero. Mechanical feed stop eliminated penalty risk. Final competition intake.

versions.name: Single Motor Flywheel
versions.changes: 1 motor. Basic flywheel at a fixed angle. Required ~600 ms to recover between shots.
versions.result: 600 ms recovery too slow for competitive cycle times — needed more torque and flexibility.

versions.name: Dual Motor + Adjustable Hood
versions.changes: 2 motors for added torque. Dual-motor shooter reduced recovery to ~400 ms. Servo-adjustable hood allowed angle switching. Enabled shooting from anywhere on the field.
versions.result: Recovery down to ~400 ms. Adjustable hood opened full-field shooting capability.

versions.name: Steel Inertia Inserts + Limelight
versions.changes: Steel inserts added to flywheel to increase moment of inertia. Inserts lowered recovery to ~300 ms. Limelight camera added for RPM and angle control.
versions.result: 300 ms recovery. Limelight targeting enabled accurate, automated shot control. Final competition shooter.
